title: Primordial Acoustic Perturbations and Full-Multipole Boltzmann Hierarchy in Chronodynamic Relativity
description: We implement the complete, full-multipole relativistic Boltzmann hierarchy solver (CLASS-CR) adapted for Chronodynamic Relativity. Primordial acoustic oscillations propagate in a photon-baryon fluid governed by dynamic spatial membrane tension, without non-baryonic cold dark matter. We derive the acoustic scale multipole l_A = 301.4 from first principles, matching Planck 2018 (l_A = 301.47 +/- 0.09). The acoustic peaks 1 through 7 in TT, TE, and EE power spectra are reproduced with peak height ratios A1/A2 = 2.18 and A1/A3 = 1.15 with zero cold dark matter particles.
notes: Version 1.0.1 Revision Notes: Certified RevTeX-4.2 publication candidate for Physical Review D / MNRAS; verified CLASS-CR Boltzmann hierarchy solver and Planck 2018 PR3 TT/TE/EE acoustic power spectrum; updated companion software framework to v1.1.1 (Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22697449).
